known_exposure: GDT982 report full .39 line and GDT985 report selected tail; complete paragraph has not yet been opened in this author turn

constructors.effect: Explicitly open a record; no entity/endpoint/relation is silently introduced.
Produce one dictionary-fixed typed term. Opaque constants must later be consumed by an actual constructor or remain unpaid.
Introduce the candidate link relation K of a written entity; K is an explicit relation object, not an executed event.
Produce the directed edge source->target. Target/source role markers are explicitly paid in the dictionary; bare adjacency alone supplies no role.
Join their edge assertions; each remains an independently represented operand.
Relational composition; does not execute movement or assert current participant location.
Retain ordered pairs satisfying one explicitly written predicate; predicate extension remains opaque and is not picked to save consistency.
State membership/availability of the produced relation description for the explicit current record; no arrival-state check.
State equality/inclusion/disjointness, with one dictionary-fixed comparator per spelling.
Close and render the written claims; cannot make unresolved terms disappear.

grammar_policy.scope: one five-line unit, no line resets
grammar_policy.binding: typed most-recent nonconsuming reference, or written stack order for binary operators; each use recorded
grammar_policy.scope_marking: must be a written dictionary value or explicitly priced contiguous phrase template; no per-locus clause lookup
grammar_policy.pair_direction: local A/B hypothesis only, no global r/l semantics
grammar_policy.hybrids: event conjunction and event-naming relation accounts are legitimate rivals; static types do not refute them

dictionary_policy.whole: one value per exact raw whole, shared over all repeats; typed overload only if explicitly priced and not per-occurrence
dictionary_policy.parts: only ordered existing formal decomposition if actually available; otherwise exact-whole value; no freshly invented parser
dictionary_policy.values: assign only the frozen constructor/term inventory; no unrelated material/plant/action word per singleton
dictionary_policy.aliases: every distinct whole sharing a value is paid; no automatic aliases for uncertain readings
dictionary_policy.residuals: charge every extra whole residual separately and expose contribution
dictionary_policy.unknowns: visible rows retained; if a complete interpretation cannot be built under this inventory, report exact first block rather than repair constructors

required_accounting: Every IT59, ZL59 and RF58 source group visible with ID, raw form, rule, operands, output, consumption; alternate unknowns not transparent.
prior_gloss_policy: GDT982 fluid/mixture/pour meanings are not inherited. Only abstract reciprocal shape is a motivating observation.
limitations: This finite inventory is an exploratory authoring choice, not manuscript grammar.
Opaque endpoint exchange does not identify polarity names.
Union/converse semantics must be paid, not inferred from consistency.
No semantic selection or independent confirmation.
